title: The Love for Three Logarithms: Universal Running of Dynamical Love Numbers
summary: The static tidal Love numbers of black holes vanish in general relativity (GR), but are generically non-zero, and in fact 'run' logarithmically with scale, in more general theories or beyond the static limit. We expose a model-agnostic framework for the running of Love numbers at the dynamical level, valid for any tidal perturbation on any static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat background, based on the near-zone expansion in powers of the frequency $ω$ and on the monodromy at spatial infinity. A master recurrence formula determines the monodromy generator to all orders in $ω^2$,…
